summary.en: The Philippines summoned China’s ambassador after a Chinese official warned that China could easily win a war, prompting lawmakers to call for a review of water-cannon use against Chinese vessels. Vice Admiral Rommel Supangan assumed command of the Philippine Coast Coast Guard, which rescued four people, including a child, on Hagonoy Island in Surigao del Sur. Chinese coast guard and navy ships entered waters near the Pratas Islands and Scarborough Shoal, while Taiwan’s coast guard and maritime forces repelled 16 mainland vessels in a coordinated operation. The United States and the Philippines held their 16th bilateral maritime exercise in the West Philippine Sea, and the PCG conducted an anti-piracy drill with Japan, and there were 176 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Filippinene innkaller Kinas ambassadør etter at en kinesisk tjenestemann advarte om at Kina lett kunne vinne en krig, noe som fikk lovgivere til å kreve en gjennomgang av bruk av vannkanoner mot kinesiske fartøyer. Viceadmiral Rommel Supangan overtok kommandoen i den filippinske kystvakten, som reddet fire personer, inkludert et barn, på Hagonoy-øya i Surigao del Sur. Kinesisk kystvakt og marine seilte inn i farvann nær Pratas-øyene og Scarborough-revet, mens Taiwans kystvakt og maritime styrker avviste 16 fastlandsfartøyer i en koordinert operasjon. USA og Filippinene holdt sin 16. bilaterale maritime øvelse i Vestfilippinene, og den filippinske kystvakten gjennomførte en anti-piratøvelse med Japan, og det var 176 dødsfall i krigshandlinger i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
